abstract: Maintains vertical hydraulic resolution and direct-push profiling operational duration records
system_message:
You are the Hydrogeology investigation lead (HYDRO), responsible for maintaining records regarding depth-discrete vertical sampling resolution and direct-push hydraulic logging operational duration across candidate source localization plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Single-mobilization field campaign window·Maintains vertical hydraulic resolution and direct-push profiling operational duration records（AQUIF）
information_points.content:
HYDRO-AQUIF-3RL：Under the Single-mobilization field campaign window, Multiport nested piezometric discrete interval sampling achieves a depth-discrete vertical sampling resolution of 75 cm across the 15 m to 45 m depth interval, requiring 100 h of direct-push hydraulic logging hours.
HYDRO-AQUIF-B8E：Under the Single-mobilization field campaign window, Compound-specific isotope transect profiling provides a depth-discrete vertical sampling resolution of 25 cm across the source boundary depth interval of 15 m to 45 m below ground surface, and requires 100 h of direct-push hydraulic logging hours across all planned borehole transects.
HYDRO-AQUIF-GA9：For the Single-mobilization field campaign window, Direct-push membrane interface probe logging delivers a depth-discrete vertical sampling resolution of 50 cm between 15 m and 45 m below ground surface, accompanied by 120 h of direct-push hydraulic logging hours.

information_points.title: Multi-year cumulative program window·Maintains vertical hydraulic resolution and direct-push profiling operational duration records（WELL）
information_points.content:
HYDRO-WELL-X4W：Under the Multi-year cumulative program window, Direct-push membrane interface probe logging provides a depth-discrete vertical sampling resolution of 50 cm at the 15 m to 45 m depth interval, alongside 120 h of direct-push hydraulic logging hours.
HYDRO-WELL-OBO：Under the Multi-year cumulative program window, Multiport nested piezometric discrete interval sampling exhibits a depth-discrete vertical sampling resolution of 75 cm across depths of 15 m to 45 m, requiring 100 h of direct-push hydraulic logging hours.
HYDRO-WELL-4W3：For the Multi-year cumulative program window, Compound-specific isotope transect profiling demonstrates a depth-discrete vertical sampling resolution of 25 cm across the 15 m to 45 m depth interval and logs 80 h of direct-push hydraulic logging hours.
